name: Await inside try preserves catch and finally control state

input.fixture_ref: Await a failed Gate inside try/catch/finally, then observe the resumed catch result and cleanup order.

applicability.reason: The evaluator reports try/catch/finally containing await as UnsupportedConstruct.

expect.status: Resumption retains the pending control state, cleanup stack, catch context, lexical bindings, receiver, and return target.
